html:
Ha Long Carnival takes place on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, serving locals and tourists to come and enjoy, besides there are many programs and events taking place during the holiday, especially the vibrant fireworks festival.

Ha Long is a place recognized by UNESCO as a World Natural Heritage 3 times, in addition Ha Long is also the place where many traditional and modern festivals take place. Especially on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, Ha Long also holds the Carnival with the theme “Connecting heritage, pioneering to shine”.

This year’s Carnival takes place at Sun Carnaval Square and Vo Nguyen Giap Street, this is one of the annual festivals in Ha Long, on a large scale.

Besides the Carnival, there are fashion shows and street dances taking place throughout the 2 days of April 30 – May 1. So if you travel Ha Long on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, you will join in the atmosphere of the festival.

Before the Carnaval festival, there will be the festival of Duc Ong Tran Quoc Nghien Temple, and the Ha Long Beer and Squid Festival will open at 3:00 p.m. on April 29, and the Quang Ninh Summer OCOP Fair will take place in a vibrant atmosphere from April 29 to May 4 to serve the people and visitors.

Carnaval is not only an annual festival in Ha Long, but it is also a typical cultural event of new strategic significance, affirming the position of Ha Long on the Vietnam tourism map.

This year’s Carnaval has become a place where unique intangible cultural heritages of the three regions of the country converge, such as: Binh Lieu Then singing, Hue royal court music, Central Highlands gongs, Southern amateur music… all clearly expressed through unique artistic language.

This year’s Ha Long Carnaval Festival is divided into 4 parts, the opening of the Ha Long Carnaval grand ball, the electronic music party, and the fireworks display along with many other special programs to welcome the summer of Ha Long.

It is expected that in the coming time, Ha Long will re-organize traditional festivals such as: New Rice Celebration of the Tay people, Dai Phan Festival of the San Diu ethnic group, Loi Am Pagoda Festival, Cai Lan Temple Festival, Long Tien Pagoda Festival… and traditional village festivals such as: Bang Ca Village Festival, King Le Thai To Temple Festival…

On the occasion of April 30 – May 1, Ha Long will also hold a high-altitude fireworks display at 9:30 p.m. on May 1, during the Carnaval festival in the Ha Long coastal area, lasting 15 minutes, promising to bring a night of eye-catching festival for locals and tourists during the holiday.

The fireworks displays create a unique identity for Ha Long, creating a diverse cultural space, spreading the value of heritage, cultural integration and development.

So if you are planning to find yourself a vacation during the holidays, then do not hesitate to join Vietlook travel to Ha Long tour during the holidays to experience the most interesting things during your vacation.

It can be said that Ha Long is gradually changing, creating many unique tourism products, bringing visitors unique experiences when visiting Ha Long, no matter what season of the year visitors come to Ha Long, they will encounter beautiful landscapes.
